messages.subject: README note added: Docker Desktop crash-at-startup
messages.body: Added one paragraph to the README's Hermes section, right after 'One container, not two.' and before 'The dashboard requires auth.', since that section is where the project's existing Docker-Desktop-for-Windows quirks already live rather than the corpus-focused 'Known limitations' section; it covers the symptom (engine pipe unreachable, com.docker.service Stopped, nothing on 5433), the real cause (orphaned AF_UNIX socket reparse points in AppData\Local\Docker\run and AppData\Local\docker-secrets-engine that Windows won't delete individually), the fix (rotate both directories, then start com.docker.service with elevation), and that it recurs after any hard kill. git status shows only README.md as my change (src/michael/ingest.py and tests/test_ingest.py are untouched, unrelated concurrent work from another worker); uv run pytest is green (150 passed, 5 deselected — the +1 versus last time is that concurrent test, not mine) and uv run mypy . is clean on 38 files. Nothing left on this task; awaiting your approval to commit.

messages.subject: Privacy Act 1988 ingested; 26WD confirmed present
messages.body: Ran the real local ingest of the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) DOCX (sha256 877b0f71..., verified identical to the file on disk before running) via ingest-file with --source-url intact, producing document_id 480 with 355 provisions, and confirmed all seven acceptance points against the real database: real (1)/(2) subsection markers in provision bodies, zero orphan provisions, matching sha256, a database ingestion_log row with url/host/sha256/timestamp, and -- the key check -- 26WD queried back by section number with its full operative text intact, no longer the silently-dropped contents-table false positive from Phase A. refresh_corpus_stats() ran and corpus_stats.provisions (9111) matches the live count exactly; documents went 204->205 and provisions 8756->9111 (delta 355, exact); I have no OpenRouter billing access so I could not paste an invoiced dollar figure, but the actual embedded character volume computes to /usr/bin/bash.0028-/usr/bin/bash.0111, inside the owner's approved ~/usr/bin/bash.011 estimate. Nothing else was touched -- no Railway, no existing corpus row modified, no scoping-proposal defects fixed -- and the repo working tree shows only the two already-accepted files plus an unrelated pre-existing README.md edit that is the owner's, not mine.
